name: ArtifactPanel
label: Artifact panel
description: The panel a chat opens beside the conversation to preview what it made: live content, a sandboxed page or a site, with the source a switch away.

props.name: title
props.description: The artifact's name, shown in the header and used as the panel's accessible name. Collides with the native `title` tooltip attribute on purpose: a panel has a heading, not a tooltip.

props.name: meta
props.description: A quiet line beside the name: what kind of thing this is, or which version.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading mark in the header — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode).

props.name: children
props.description: The preview, as live React content. Wins over `html` and `src`.

props.name: html
props.description: The preview, as a complete HTML document drawn in a sandboxed frame. Wins over `src`. A document that honours `prefers-color-scheme` follows the `color-scheme` of the page around the panel, so set that with your theme and the preview turns light or dark with it.

props.name: src
props.description: The preview, as a URL drawn in a sandboxed frame: a deployed page, a site.

props.name: sandbox
props.description: The frame's `sandbox` tokens for `html` and `src`. The default lets a document run its own scripts and forms in an origin of its own, with no reach into the host page; widen it only for a source you trust.

props.name: frameTitle
props.description: Accessible name for the preview frame. Defaults to the title when that is a string.

props.name: code
props.description: The artifact's source. Given, the header offers a Code view beside the preview (or shows the code alone when there is no preview).

props.name: language
props.description: The source's language, shown on the code view.

props.name: view
props.description: The view on stage, when the host owns the state.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The view the panel opens on when it keeps its own state.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Fires with the chosen view.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the host is showing the panel at its expanded size. The panel never sizes itself: this only picks the toggle's icon and name.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires with the next state when the expand toggle is pressed. The toggle renders only when this is given.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fires when the close button is pressed. The button renders only when this is given.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra header controls, seated ahead of the expand and close buttons: a download, a share, a version menu.

props.name: previewLabel
props.description: Label for the preview segment of the view switch.

props.name: codeLabel
props.description: Label for the code segment of the view switch.

props.name: viewLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the view switch.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the expand toggle while the panel is at its resting size.

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the expand toggle while the panel is expanded.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the close button.

props.name: codeBlockLabels
props.description: The words the code view's CodeBlock writes, merged over its English defaults: the copy button's name and text ("Copy code", "Copy", "Copied") and the code region's name ("Code: <language>").

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes
